roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Full unconstrained administrative access across all clinical, financial, and system setup configurations.

roles.name: Doctor / Dentist Specialist
roles.description: Full access to live queue, clinical appointments, patient medical records, treatment session charting, and prescriptions.

roles.name: Receptionist & Front Desk
roles.description: Front-desk check-in, token queue, appointment scheduling, patient intake, billing payments, and WhatsApp communication.

roles.name: Clinical Assistant / Staff
roles.description: Assists with patient movement, token queue calls, basic appointments, and clinical procedures.

roles.name: Dental Nurse & Caregiver
roles.description: Chairside assistance, patient preparation, sterilization notes, and post-procedure care.
